p_t: The two leaks in any business
p_s: It doesn't matter whether you sell consultations, food, houses, classes or spare parts. Money escapes through the same two places.
f1_t: The customer wants to pay and can't
f1_d: They ask your price by message, you reply, you send your bank details, they think it over and go cold. Every extra step between intent and payment costs you sales.
f2_t: The customer writes and nobody answers
f2_d: They write at eleven at night, on a Sunday, or while you're serving someone else. Whoever gets no answer in minutes writes to the next business. That sale doesn't come back.

q_l:
Is the discount real?

Yes. Forja Labs is opening and would rather fill its calendar with real clients than with list prices. Half price applies to the build, not the monthly service, and it ends on 16 March 2027.

Is my business too small for this?

If customers already write to you, it isn't. The smaller the team, the more each unanswered message costs.

Do I need to understand technology?

No. You tell us about your business and approve what we show you. We do the rest and hand you a simple manual.

Where does my customers' money go?

Into your own Stripe account, connected to your bank. Forja Labs never touches your payments.

Can the agent make things up?

It is trained on your real business information with explicit instructions on what not to answer. When it doesn't know, it says so and hands the conversation over. You approve the answers before it goes live.

Will the agent put customers off?

It introduces itself as an assistant, never pretends to be you, and hands over the conversation as soon as there's a complaint or a negotiation. The real alternative isn't you replying instantly: it's nobody replying.

Why does the agent have a monthly fee and the page doesn't?

Because every conversation consumes AI and hosting that are paid month by month. Once delivered, the page consumes nothing: its maintenance is optional.

What if I don't like what I see?

You see it before we build anything. If there's no agreement at the proposal stage, the second 50% isn't paid and that's the end of it.

Do you issue invoices?

Yes. Say so when you hire us and we'll ask for your tax details.
fin_d: One message is enough. I reply the same day and tell you what suits you, even if the answer is that you don't need anything yet.
